interests.title: Psychological Interventions & Psychotherapy
interests.description: How and for whom psychological support produces meaningful change, including psychotherapy process and outcomes and scalable mental health programs.

interests.title: Self-Concept, Self-Esteem & Socioemotional Development
interests.description: Developmental patterns in self-perception, emotion regulation, sleep, and well-being, with an interest in emerging adulthood.

interests.title: Longitudinal & Person-Centered Methods
interests.description: Understanding individual pathways through growth models, latent profiles and transitions, and multi-informant longitudinal data.

interests.title: Multicultural Adjustment & Lived Experience
interests.description: How cultural, relational, and institutional contexts shape adjustment, identity, and psychological needs; informed by qualitative and mixed-method research.

experiences.title: Person-Centered Reanalysis of Longitudinal Self-Concept Data
experiences.role: Researcher & Data Analyst | Independent Research Project
experiences.summary: Secondary reanalysis of the school-based SEL dataset used in my master’s thesis at National Taiwan University.
bullets: Applying LPA across waves to identify heterogeneous scholastic and social self-concept profiles, and LTA to examine their stability and transitions.
Using BCH distal outcome analyses to compare global self-worth across profiles. These analyses are ongoing.

experiences.title: Food Sharing, Self-Presentation, and Identity Construction on Social Media
experiences.role: Researcher & Group Presenter | Shanghai Normal University
experiences.summary: Digital ethnographic research during the “Go to the Field” summer training camp on food practices, relationships, identity, and transitions into adult roles.
bullets: Contributed to a group study synthesizing interviews with 64 young adults and presented the final group findings.
Conducted an individual mixed-method study with 14 participants aged 18–35, using interviews and photo-elicitation.
Examined platform-specific self-presentation, relational meaning, and autobiographical memory. An exploratory self-esteem analysis with nine participants showed a non-significant pre–post change.

experiences.title: Trauma-Informed, Recovery-Oriented Care for Women
experiences.role: Research Assistant & Group Co-Leader | National Taiwan University, Department of Social Work
experiences.summary: Evaluation of a localized Trauma Recovery and Empowerment Model (TREM)-based group intervention for women with substance-use and trauma histories.
bullets: Co-facilitated a 12-session program in a community addiction treatment center and Taoyuan Women’s Prison.
Contributed to a mixed-method longitudinal study with 69 intervention and 40 comparison participants, assessed before and after treatment and at 3-, 6-, and 10-month follow-ups.
Integrated standardized outcomes with in-depth interviews and structured field observations.

experiences.title: Mindfulness and Photo-Diary Interventions for University Students
experiences.role: Intervention Designer & Data Analyst | Guangzhou College of Commerce
experiences.summary: Designed and implemented mental health programs combining mindfulness, photography, reflective writing, experiential activities, and psychoeducation.
bullets: Developed the “21-Day Soul Camera” photo-diary program, engaging more than 800 faculty members and students.
Led the “Mindfulness Journey” program with 1,001 participants.
Collected pre–post outcomes and applied repeated-measures analyses and estimated marginal means to examine change.

experiences.title: Socioemotional Development and School-Based SEL in Preadolescence
experiences.role: Research Assistant & Data Analyst | National Taiwan University, Laboratory of Socioemotional Development
experiences.summary: A two-year, six-wave study of developmental trajectories and differential effects of a school-based social-emotional learning curriculum.
bullets: Led management and cleaning of multi-informant data involving more than 2,000 students, parents, and teachers.
Applied ALT and multi-group ALT to four-wave self-concept and self-esteem data, alongside latent-variable and longitudinal analyses.
Developed a coding system for open-ended problem-solving responses, trained undergraduate coders, and assessed inter-rater reliability.
This work formed the basis of my master’s thesis and a first-author presentation at the 2019 ENSEC Conference.

experiences.title: Culturally Adapted SEL for School-Age Children in Beijing
experiences.role: Research Assistant & Data Analyst | National Taiwan University
experiences.summary: Multi-school evaluation of a culturally adapted SEL curriculum with fourth-, fifth-, and seventh-grade students.
bullets: Analyzed student and parent data from a two-year, five-wave study of emotional intelligence.
Used ANCOVA, hierarchical regression, and moderation analyses to examine intervention-related gains, parenting, and parent–child attachment.
Observed heterogeneous effects across grades, schools, and reporters.

experiences.title: Maternal Beliefs and Preschoolers’ Motivational Choices
experiences.role: Course Research Project | National Taiwan University
experiences.summary: Examined maternal beliefs, achievement-goal orientations, and children’s choices in a challenging task context.
bullets: Prepared questionnaire and behavioral-task data from 77 preschoolers and their mothers.
Conducted correlation and regression analyses using maternal questionnaires and the Finding Where’s Rabbit iPad visual-search task.

experiences.title: Visitor Behavior and Educational Effects in a Safari Park
experiences.role: Undergraduate Thesis Researcher | Sun Yat-sen University
experiences.summary: Mixed-methods thesis on visitor behavior, viewing preferences, and educational experiences.
bullets: Observed 507 visitor groups across six animal exhibits; combined behavioral and participant observation, interviews, and questionnaires.
Applied hierarchical regression, contingency analyses, and Mann–Whitney U tests in SPSS.

experiences.title: Household Labor and Gender-Role Expectations in Hakka Families
experiences.summary: Qualitative case study of modernization, urbanization, and family labor allocation.
bullets: Used participant observation and in-depth interviews, comparing cases across generations and family types.
Examined how gender-role expectations are negotiated and transmitted through everyday interactions.

experiences.title: Education and Adolescent Development in Rural Yao Communities
experiences.role: Field Research Intern | Sun Yat-sen University
experiences.summary: Month-long anthropological fieldwork in Gongcheng Yao Autonomous County on rural education and adolescent development.
bullets: Combined observation, interviews, and psychological measures to examine caregiving, migration, schooling, and adjustment.
Produced a nearly 30,000-character field report on personality development and educational change.
